title: LLMs and Cultural Values: the Impact of Prompt Language and Explicit Cultural Framing
findings: LLMs showed high variation regarding the importance of religion, similar to humans. Prompt language significantly influenced responses in a way that aligned with cultural trends (e.g., Arabic prompts led to higher importance ratings than Chinese prompts did), with GPT4o showing the best alignment with human responses on this topic. Regarding qualities to encourage in children, LLMs value 'faith' much less than humans do (5% vs. 28%). When asked about dependency on science vs. faith, LLMs were slightly less likely than humans to agree that people depend 'too much on science and not enough on faith'.
